items.why: Officially active for SNF despite knee uncertainty.
items.implication: Playable but monitor for decoy/limited snaps.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if full go.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cardinals wouldn't activate if overly worried about ankle.
items.why: Team activated him despite ankle; risk remains as it's the Cardinals.
items.implication: Start as RB2 everywhere with upside but injury risk.
items.opportunity: Full role expected if healthy enough to play.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play; status affects Travis Etienne projection.
items.opportunity: Etienne full workload, fringe backs behind.

items.text: Weekend reports: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play; Alvin Kamara (knee) not; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Malik Nabers (knee) no news yet (later active).
items.implication: Key actives lock in roles; Kamara absence boosts Etienne.
corroboration: @adamlevitan roughly all main slate news in

items.text: Watching Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ladd McConkey (chest) who left early; post-game injury watch.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 status; potential absences open targets.

items.text: Risk reward because maybe decoy but starting Malik Nabers wherever owned after active.
items.why: Active confirmed; decoy possible but start.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out wrist; initial diagnosis fractured wrist, further testing/MRI, out several weeks.
items.why: Wrist injury in game, fractured per sources.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth elevated; Flowers etc. more volume if healthy.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on his high ankle sprain, but he will be sidelined 4 to 6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain, no surgery required.
items.implication: Long-term stash; look to NE WR depth short-term.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially is active today.
items.why: Cleared and active after calf/foot concerns.
items.opportunity: WR role in high-scoring potential attack.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; team optimistic on quick return.
items.opportunity: TE targets open short-term in LV.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 performance signals ongoing role.
items.opportunity: TE targets in BAL with Andrews.

items.text: Combine Flowers/McConkey/Thomas/Murray/etc exits with Brock Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Sam Darnold (hip); not a clean start for injuries. Main slate news locked except Nabers murky then resolved.
items.why: Multiple early exits and known absences pile up.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason take was want as much Bears offense as possible and that hasn't changed despite Week 1.
items.why: Week 1 weirdness/targets to others; still likes Bears offense share.
items.opportunity: TE role in CHI passing attack.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk with new OC Sean Mannion from Packers.
